title: Apply for design practitioner registration
summary: Learn about the requirements and steps to register as a design or principal design practitioner in NSW.
intro:

faqs.q: What is the purpose of design practitioner registration?
faqs.a: Registration is required to make compliance declarations and lodge regulated designs on the NSW Planning Portal for regulated buildings.

faqs.q: How long can I register as a design practitioner?
faqs.a: You can register for 1, 3, or 5 years.

faqs.q: What are the eligibility requirements to apply?
faqs.a: You must be aged 18 or over, have the necessary knowledge, skills, qualifications, and experience, have a current National Police Check, have completed mandatory Construct NSW learning modules, and meet insurance requirements. You cannot register if you are an undischarged bankrupt.
